Successfully built and tested, the cloak could transform electronics cooling, thermal protection, and stealth technology.

excerpt: Mathematicians have uncovered what they argue is a fundamental flaw in the standard model of the universe, potentially challenging the need for dark energy. The findings also raise surprising questions about whether our location in the universe is as ordinary as scientists have long assumed.
